load_obj_mesh: load a 3D mesh from an OBJ file with vertices, faces, normals, and texture UV coordinates
load_objs_as_meshes: load multiple OBJ files as a batched PyTorch3D Meshes object with optional texture atlas creation
save_obj_mesh: save a 3D mesh with vertices and faces to an OBJ file with optional texture map and MTL support
parse_obj_face: parse an OBJ face line to extract vertex, texture, and normal indices with triangulation for polygons
mesh_obj_format_interpreter: use the MeshObjFormat class to read OBJ files into Meshes or save Meshes back to OBJ format
